description: Author-only: commit this benchmark's task bank under a salted Merkle root (API key required; the author is your key). One bank, one root: once anchored on-chain a repeat is a conflict carrying the root. Arg: slug (defaults to the routed benchmark). Returns benchmark_slug, merkle_root, leaf_count, anchor_status, tx_hash, chain_id, committed_at. REST twin: POST /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}/commit. Next: benchmark_commitment.

inputSchema.description: A benchmark slug that defaults to the routed benchmark on its rail.

slug.description: Benchmark slug from benchmarks_list or benchmarks_search. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug
